english: Early blight causes brown spots on old tomato leaves.
translated: ప్రారంభ వ్యాధి పాత టమోటా ఆకులపై గోధుమ రంగు మచ్చలను కలిగిస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Early disease causes brown spots on the leaves of old tomatoes.

english: Bacterial leaf spot makes small dark spots on chilli leaves.
translated: బాక్టీరియల్ ఆకు మచ్చ మిరపకాయల ఆకులపై చిన్న నల్లటి మచ్చలను చేస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Bacterial leaf spotting makes small black spots on the leaves of chili peppers.

english: Powdery mildew forms white powder on the leaves.
translated: బూజు బూజు ఆకులపై తెల్లని పొడిని ఏర్పరుస్తుంది.
back_to_english: The fungus forms a white powder on the leaves of the fungus.

english: Downy mildew spreads fast in cool and wet weather.
translated: చల్లని మరియు తడి వాతావరణంలో డౌనీ బూజు వేగంగా వ్యాపిస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Downy mildew spreads rapidly in cold and wet weather.

english: Rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.
translated: తుప్పు వ్యాధి గోధుమ ఆకుల కింద నారింజ మచ్చలను చూపుతుంది.
back_to_english: The rust disease shows orange spots under the brown leaves.

english: Fusarium wilt makes the whole plant droop and dry.
translated: ఫ్యూజేరియం విల్ట్ మొత్తం మొక్కను వదులుతూ పొడిగా చేస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Fusarium wilt leaves the entire plant dry.

english: Root rot happens when water stays in the field for long.
translated: పొలంలో ఎక్కువసేపు నీరు నిలిచిపోయినప్పుడు వేర్లు తెగిపోతాయి.
back_to_english: When the water in the field is stagnant for a long time, the roots break.

english: Mosaic virus makes the leaves curl with yellow patches.
translated: మొజాయిక్ వైరస్ ఆకులను పసుపు మచ్చలతో వంకరగా చేస్తుంది.
back_to_english: The mosaic virus makes the leaves curly with yellow spots.

english: Thrips suck the sap from chilli leaves.
translated: మిరపకాయల ఆకుల నుండి త్రిప్స్ రసాన్ని పీల్చుకుంటుంది.
back_to_english: Thrips suck the juice from the leaves of the chilli.

english: Whitefly spreads leaf curl virus in tomato.
translated: వైట్ ఫ్లై టమోటాలో ఆకు కర్ల్ వైరస్ను వ్యాపింపజేస్తుంది.
back_to_english: The whitefly spreads the leaf curl virus in tomatoes.

english: Aphids gather on young shoots and suck the sap.
translated: అఫిడ్స్ చిన్న రెమ్మలపై సేకరించి రసాన్ని పీల్చుకుంటాయి.
back_to_english: Aphids gather on small shoots and inhale the juice.

english: Stem borer damages the paddy stem from inside.
translated: కాండం కొరికేది వరి కాండం లోపలి నుండి దెబ్బతీస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Stem bites damage the rice stem from the inside.

english: Caterpillars eat holes in the cabbage leaves.
translated: గొంగళి పురుగులు క్యాబేజీ ఆకులలో రంధ్రాలను తింటాయి.
back_to_english: Caterpillars feed on holes in cabbage leaves.

english: Red spider mites make the leaves look dusty and pale.
translated: ఎర్ర సాలీడు పురుగులు ఆకులను దుమ్ము దులుపుతూ, లేతగా కనిపించేలా చేస్తాయి.
back_to_english: Red spider mites dust the leaves and make them look pale.

english: Check the crop for pests every week.
translated: ప్రతి వారం పంటను తెగుళ్ళ కోసం తనిఖీ చేయండి.
back_to_english: Check the crop for pests every week.

english: Spray a fungicide after removing the infected leaves.
translated: వ్యాధి సోకిన ఆకులను తొలగించిన తర్వాత శిలీంధ్రనాశకాన్ని చల్లండి.
back_to_english: Spray the fungicide after removing the infected leaves.

english: Use an insecticide only when the pests are many.
translated: తెగుళ్ళు ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు మాత్రమే పురుగుమందులను ఉపయోగించండి.
back_to_english: Use insecticides only when pests are high.

english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.
translated: ఏదైనా పురుగుమందులను చల్లేటప్పుడు చేతి తొడుగులు, మాస్క్ ధరించండి.
back_to_english: Wear gloves and a mask when spraying any pesticides.

english: Apply the fertilizer after the first weeding.
translated: మొదటి కలుపు తీయడం తర్వాత ఎరువులను అప్లై చేయండి.
back_to_english: Apply fertilizer after the first weeding.

english: Apply urea in two split doses.
translated: యూరియాను రెండు భాగాలుగా పూయండి.
back_to_english: Apply urea in two parts.

english: Mix compost into the soil before sowing.
translated: విత్తనాలు వేసే ముందు మట్టిలో కంపోస్ట్ కలపండి.
back_to_english: Before sowing, mix the compost in the soil.

english: Transplant the seedlings after twenty five days.
translated: ఇరవై ఐదు రోజుల తర్వాత మొలకలను నాటండి.
back_to_english: Plant the seedlings after twenty-five days.

english: Keep two centimetres of water in the paddy field.
translated: వరి పొలంలో రెండు సెంటీమీటర్ల నీటిని ఉంచండి.
back_to_english: Keep two centimeters of water in the rice field.

english: Groundnut needs light soil with good drainage.
translated: వేరుశెనగకు మంచి పారుదలతో కూడిన తేలికపాటి మట్టి అవసరం.
back_to_english: Peanuts require light soil with good drainage.

english: Pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.
translated: పింక్ బోల్వర్మ్ అనేది పత్తి యొక్క తీవ్రమైన తెగులు.
back_to_english: Pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.

english: Chilli plants need water every four days in summer.
translated: వేసవిలో ప్రతి నాలుగు రోజులకు ఒకసారి మిరపకాయల మొక్కలకు నీరు అవసరం.
back_to_english: Chilli plants need water once every four days in the summer.

english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.
translated: నాటిన ఇరవై రోజుల తర్వాత మొదటి కలుపు తీయడం చేయండి.
back_to_english: Do the first weeding twenty days after planting.

english: Avoid overhead irrigation to stop the disease spreading.
translated: వ్యాధి వ్యాప్తి చెందకుండా ఉండటానికి ఓవర్ హెడ్ ఇరిగేషన్ నివారించండి.
back_to_english: Avoid overhead irrigation to prevent the spread of disease.

english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.
translated: పంట మార్పిడి అనేది మట్టి వ్యాధుల జీవిత చక్రాన్ని విచ్ఛిన్నం చేస్తుంది.
back_to_english: Crop transplantation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.

english: Yellowing of lower leaves can mean nitrogen deficiency.
translated: దిగువ ఆకులు పసుపు రంగులోకి మారడం అంటే నత్రజని లోపం అని అర్థం.
back_to_english: The yellowing of the lower leaves means a lack of nitrogen.

english: Early blight causes brown spots on old tomato leaves.
translated: ಮುಂಚಿನ ರೋಗವು ಹಳೆಯ ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂದು ಕಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Early disease causes brown spots on old tomato leaves.

english: Bacterial leaf spot makes small dark spots on chilli leaves.
translated: ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾದ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಮೆಣಸಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಪ್ಪು ಕಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
back_to_english: The bacterial leaves produce small black spots on the pepper leaves.

english: Powdery mildew forms white powder on the leaves.
translated: ಬೂದು ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರವು ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿ ಪುಡಿಯನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The grey fungus forms a white powder on the leaves.

english: Downy mildew spreads fast in cool and wet weather.
translated: ತಂಪಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ದ್ರ ಹವಾಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರವು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The fungus spreads rapidly in cold and wet weather.

english: Rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.
translated: ತುಕ್ಕು ರೋಗವು ಗೋಧಿ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕಿತ್ತಳೆ ಕಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.

english: Fusarium wilt makes the whole plant droop and dry.
translated: ಫ್ಯೂಜೇರಿಯಂ ವಿಲ್ಟ್ ಇಡೀ ಸಸ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮುಳುಗಿಸಿ ಒಣಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Fusarium wilt dries the entire plant by immersing it.

english: Root rot happens when water stays in the field for long.
translated: ನೀರು ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದವರೆಗೆ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದುಕೊಂಡಾಗ ಬೇರು ಕೊಳೆತವು ಸಂಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Root rot occurs when water stays in the field for a long time.

english: Mosaic virus makes the leaves curl with yellow patches.
translated: ಮೊಸಾಯಿಕ್ ವೈರಸ್ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಳದಿ ಕಲೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸುರುಳಿಯಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The mosaic virus coils the leaves with yellow spots.

english: Thrips suck the sap from chilli leaves.
translated: ಮೆಣಸಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳಿಂದ ರಸದ ರಸವನ್ನು ಥ್ರಿಪ್ಸ್ ಹೀರಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Thrips absorb the juice of the juice from the leaves of the pepper.

english: Whitefly spreads leaf curl virus in tomato.
translated: ಬಿಳಿ ನೊಣವು ಟೊಮೆಟೊದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆಯ ಕರ್ಲ್ ವೈರಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The white fly transmits the leaf curl virus in tomatoes.

english: Aphids gather on young shoots and suck the sap.
translated: ಗಿಡಹೇನುಗಳು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಚಿಗುರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿ ರಸವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.
back_to_english: Aphids gather on small shoots and suck the juice.

english: Stem borer damages the paddy stem from inside.
translated: ಕಾಂಡವನ್ನು ಕೊರೆಯುವ ಯಂತ್ರವು ಭತ್ತದ ಕಾಂಡವನ್ನು ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಹಾನಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The stem drilling machine damages the rice stem from the inside.

english: Caterpillars eat holes in the cabbage leaves.
translated: ಮರಿಹುಳುಗಳು ಎಲೆಕೋಸು ಎಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ರಂಧ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತವೆ.
back_to_english: The caterpillars feed on the holes in the cabbage leaves.

english: Red spider mites make the leaves look dusty and pale.
translated: ಕೆಂಪು ಜೇಡ ಹುಳಗಳು ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಧೂಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಸುಕಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
back_to_english: Red spider mites make the leaves look dusty and faint.

english: Check the crop for pests every week.
translated: ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಕೀಟಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Check crops for pests every week.

english: Spray a fungicide after removing the infected leaves.
translated: ಸೋಂಕಿತ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿದ ನಂತರ ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರನಾಶಕವನ್ನು ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Spray fungicide after removing the infected leaves.

english: Use an insecticide only when the pests are many.
translated: ಕೀಟಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.
back_to_english: Use an insecticide only when there are too many pests.

english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.
translated: ನೀವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕವನ್ನು ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸುವಾಗ ಕೈಗವಸುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಖವಾಡವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.

english: Apply the fertilizer after the first weeding.
translated: ಮೊದಲ ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯುವಿಕೆಯ ನಂತರ ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರವನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Apply fertilizer after the first weed removal.

english: Apply urea in two split doses.
translated: ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳಾಗಿ ಯೂರಿಯಾವನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Apply urea in two parts.

english: Mix compost into the soil before sowing.
translated: ಬಿತ್ತನೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಂಪೋಸ್ಟ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬೆರೆಸಿ.
back_to_english: Before sowing mix the compost in the soil.

english: Transplant the seedlings after twenty five days.
translated: ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೈದು ದಿನಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮೊಳಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಸಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
back_to_english: After twenty-five days transplant the seedlings.

english: Keep two centimetres of water in the paddy field.
translated: ಭತ್ತದ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಸೆಂಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ನೀರನ್ನು ಇರಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Place two centimeters of water in the rice field.

english: Groundnut needs light soil with good drainage.
translated: ಕಡಲೆಕಾಯಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಒಳಚರಂಡಿ ಇರುವ ಹಗುರವಾದ ಮಣ್ಣು ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Peanuts require light soil with good drainage.

english: Pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.
translated: ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಬೋಲ್ವರ್ಮ್ ಹತ್ತಿಯ ಗಂಭೀರ ಕೀಟವಾಗಿದೆ.
back_to_english: The pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.

english: Chilli plants need water every four days in summer.
translated: ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ದಿನಗಳಿಗೊಮ್ಮೆ ನೀರಿನ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Pepper plants need water every four days during the summer.

english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.
translated: ಬಿತ್ತನೆಯ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮೊದಲ ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿ.
back_to_english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.

english: Avoid overhead irrigation to stop the disease spreading.
translated: ರೋಗ ಹರಡುವುದನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲು ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ನೀರಾವರಿಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ.
back_to_english: Avoid surface irrigation to prevent the spread of disease.

english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.
translated: ಬೆಳೆ ಆವರ್ತನವು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ರೋಗಗಳ ಜೀವನ ಚಕ್ರವನ್ನು ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.

english: Yellowing of lower leaves can mean nitrogen deficiency.
translated: ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣವು ಸಾರಜನಕದ ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
back_to_english: The yellow colour of the lower leaves indicates a lack of nitrogen.

english: Early blight causes brown spots on old tomato leaves.
translated: जल्दी होने वाले रोग के कारण पुराने टमाटर के पत्तों पर भूरे रंग के धब्बे पड़ जाते हैं।
back_to_english: The early disease causes brown spots on the leaves of old tomatoes.

english: Bacterial leaf spot makes small dark spots on chilli leaves.
translated: बैक्टीरियल पत्ती का धब्बा मिर्च के पत्तों पर छोटे काले धब्बे बनाता है।

english: Bacterial leaf spot makes small dark spots on chilli leaves.
translated: بیکٹیریل پتی کا دھبہ مرچ کے پتوں پر چھوٹے سیاہ دھبے بناتا ہے۔
back_to_english: The bacterial leaf spot forms small black spots on the chili leaves.

english: Powdery mildew forms white powder on the leaves.
translated: پاؤڈر پھپھوندی پتیوں پر سفید پاؤڈر بناتی ہے۔
back_to_english: The powdery mildew forms a white powder on the leaves.

english: Downy mildew spreads fast in cool and wet weather.
translated: ٹھنڈے اور گیلے موسم میں پھپھوندی تیزی سے پھیلتی ہے۔
back_to_english: The fungus spreads rapidly in cold and wet weather.

english: Rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.
translated: زنگ کی بیماری گندم کے پتوں کے نیچے نارنجی رنگ کے دھبے دکھاتی ہے۔
back_to_english: The rust disease shows orange patches under the wheat leaves.

english: Fusarium wilt makes the whole plant droop and dry.
translated: فیوزیریم ولٹ پورے پودے کو ٹپک کر خشک کر دیتا ہے۔
back_to_english: The fusarium wilt drips and dries the entire plant.

english: Root rot happens when water stays in the field for long.
translated: جڑوں کا سڑنا اس وقت ہوتا ہے جب پانی کھیت میں زیادہ دیر تک رہتا ہے۔
back_to_english: Root rot occurs when water stays in the field for a long time.

english: Mosaic virus makes the leaves curl with yellow patches.
translated: موزیک وائرس پتیوں کو پیلے رنگ کے دھبوں سے گھوماتا ہے۔
back_to_english: The mosaic virus swirls the leaves with yellow spots.

english: Thrips suck the sap from chilli leaves.
translated: تھریپس مرچی کے پتوں کا رس چوستے ہیں۔
back_to_english: Therapies suck the juice of chilli leaves.

english: Whitefly spreads leaf curl virus in tomato.
translated: سفید مکھی ٹماٹر میں لیف کرل وائرس پھیلاتی ہے۔
back_to_english: White flies transmit leaf curl virus to tomatoes.

english: Aphids gather on young shoots and suck the sap.
translated: ایفیڈز چھوٹی کونپلوں پر جمع ہوتے ہیں اور رس چوستے ہیں۔
back_to_english: Aphids gather on small shoots and suck the juice.

english: Stem borer damages the paddy stem from inside.
translated: ڈنڈہ چھیدنے والا دھان کے ڈنڈے کو اندر سے نقصان پہنچاتا ہے۔
back_to_english: The rod piercer damages the paddy stalk from the inside.

english: Caterpillars eat holes in the cabbage leaves.
translated: کیٹرپلر گوبھی کے پتوں میں سوراخ کھا جاتے ہیں۔
back_to_english: Caterpillars eat holes in the leaves of the cabbage.

english: Red spider mites make the leaves look dusty and pale.
translated: سرخ مکڑی کے کیڑے پتوں کو دھول دار اور پیلا دکھاتے ہیں۔
back_to_english: Red spider mites make the leaves appear dusty and yellow.

english: Check the crop for pests every week.
translated: ہر ہفتے کیڑوں کے لیے فصل کی جانچ کریں۔
back_to_english: Check the crop for pests every week.

english: Spray a fungicide after removing the infected leaves.
translated: متاثرہ پتیوں کو ہٹانے کے بعد فنگسائڈ کا چھڑکاؤ کریں۔
back_to_english: Spray the fungus after removing the affected leaves.

english: Use an insecticide only when the pests are many.
translated: کیڑے مار دوا کا استعمال تب ہی کریں جب کیڑے بہت زیادہ ہوں۔
back_to_english: Use pesticides only when there are too many insects.

english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.
translated: جب آپ کسی بھی کیڑے مار دوا کا چھڑکاؤ کریں تو دستانے اور ماسک پہنیں۔
back_to_english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.

english: Apply the fertilizer after the first weeding.
translated: پہلی نکاسی کے بعد کھاد لگائیں۔
back_to_english: Apply fertilizer after the first drainage.

english: Apply urea in two split doses.
translated: یوریا کو دو تقسیم شدہ خوراکوں میں لگائیں۔
back_to_english: Put the urea in two divided doses.

english: Mix compost into the soil before sowing.
translated: بوائی سے پہلے کھاد کو مٹی میں ملا لیں۔
back_to_english: Before sowing, mix the manure in the soil.

english: Transplant the seedlings after twenty five days.
translated: پچیس دن کے بعد پودوں کو ٹرانسپلانٹ کریں۔
back_to_english: Transplant the plants after twenty-five days.

english: Keep two centimetres of water in the paddy field.
translated: دھان کے کھیت میں دو سینٹی میٹر پانی رکھیں۔
back_to_english: Keep two centimeters of water in the paddy field.

english: Groundnut needs light soil with good drainage.
translated: مونگ پھلی کو اچھی نکاسی کے ساتھ ہلکی مٹی کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔
back_to_english: Peanuts require light soil with good drainage.

english: Pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.
translated: گلابی کیڑا کپاس کا ایک سنگین کیڑا ہے۔
back_to_english: The pink moth is a serious cotton pest.

english: Chilli plants need water every four days in summer.
translated: مرچی کے پودوں کو موسم گرما میں ہر چار دن بعد پانی کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔
back_to_english: Chilli plants need water every four days in summer.

english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.
translated: بوائی کے بیس دن بعد پہلی نکاسی کریں۔
back_to_english: Do the first drainage twenty days after sowing.

english: Avoid overhead irrigation to stop the disease spreading.
translated: بیماری کے پھیلاؤ کو روکنے کے لیے اوپر کی آبپاشی سے گریز کریں۔
back_to_english: Avoid top irrigation to prevent the spread of disease.

english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.
translated: فصل کی گردش مٹی کی بیماریوں کے زندگی کے چکر کو توڑ دیتی ہے۔
back_to_english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.

english: Yellowing of lower leaves can mean nitrogen deficiency.
translated: نچلے پتوں کے پیلے ہونے کا مطلب نائٹروجن کی کمی ہو سکتی ہے۔
back_to_english: Yellowing of the lower leaves may mean a lack of nitrogen.

english: Early blight causes brown spots on old tomato leaves.
translated: ஆரம்பகால புண் பழைய தக்காளி இலைகளில் பழுப்பு நிற புள்ளிகளை ஏற்படுத்துகிறது.
back_to_english: The early ulcer causes brown spots on the old tomato leaves.

english: Bacterial leaf spot makes small dark spots on chilli leaves.
translated: பாக்டீரியல் இலை புள்ளி மிளகாய் இலைகளில் சிறிய கருப்பு புள்ளிகளை உருவாக்குகிறது.
back_to_english: The bacterial leaf spot forms small black dots on the chili leaves.

english: Powdery mildew forms white powder on the leaves.
translated: தூள் பூஞ்சை இலைகளில் வெள்ளை தூளை உருவாக்குகிறது.
back_to_english: The powdery mildew forms a white powder on the leaves.

english: Downy mildew spreads fast in cool and wet weather.
translated: குளிர்ந்த மற்றும் ஈரமான காலநிலைகளில் பூஞ்சை வேகமாக பரவுகிறது.
back_to_english: The fungus spreads rapidly in cold and wet climates.

english: Rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.
translated: துரு நோய் கோதுமை இலைகளின் கீழ் ஆரஞ்சு புள்ளிகளைக் காட்டுகிறது.
back_to_english: The rust disease shows orange spots under the wheat leaves.

english: Fusarium wilt makes the whole plant droop and dry.
translated: ஃபுசேரியம் வில்ட் தாவரம் முழுவதையும் வறண்டு வறண்டு போகச் செய்கிறது.
back_to_english: Fusarium wilt causes the entire plant to dry out.

english: Root rot happens when water stays in the field for long.
translated: வயலில் தண்ணீர் நீண்ட நேரம் இருக்கும்போது வேர் அழுகல் ஏற்படுகிறது.
back_to_english: Root rot occurs when the field is watered for a long time.

english: Mosaic virus makes the leaves curl with yellow patches.
translated: மொசைக் வைரஸ் இலைகளை மஞ்சள் திட்டுகளுடன் சுருட்டுகிறது.
back_to_english: The mosaic virus coils the leaves with yellow patches.

english: Thrips suck the sap from chilli leaves.
translated: மிளகாய் இலைகளில் இருந்து மிளகாய் சாறு உறிஞ்சப்படுகிறது.
back_to_english: Chilli juice is absorbed from the chilli leaves.

english: Whitefly spreads leaf curl virus in tomato.
translated: வெள்ளை ஈ எலையில் சுருண்டிருக்கும் வைரஸைப் பரப்புகிறது.
back_to_english: The white fly spreads the virus by wrapping itself in a leaf.

english: Aphids gather on young shoots and suck the sap.
translated: அஃபிட்கள் இளம் தளிர்களில் கூடி சாற்றை உறிஞ்சுகின்றன.
back_to_english: The aphids gather in young shoots and absorb the juice.

english: Stem borer damages the paddy stem from inside.
translated: தண்டு துளைப்பவர் நெல் தண்டு உள்ளே இருந்து சேதப்படுத்துகிறது.
back_to_english: The stem borer damages the paddy stem from the inside.

english: Caterpillars eat holes in the cabbage leaves.
translated: கேட்டர்பில்லர்கள் முட்டைக்கோஸ் இலைகளில் உள்ள துளைகளை சாப்பிடுகின்றன.
back_to_english: Caterpillars eat the holes in cabbage leaves.

english: Red spider mites make the leaves look dusty and pale.
translated: சிவப்பு சிலந்தி பூச்சிகள் இலைகளை தூசி மற்றும் வெளிர் நிறமாக தோற்றமளிக்கிறது.
back_to_english: Red spider mites give the leaves a dusty and pale appearance.

english: Check the crop for pests every week.
translated: ஒவ்வொரு வாரமும் பயிரை பூச்சிகளுக்காக சரிபார்க்கவும்.
back_to_english: Check the crop for pests every week.

english: Spray a fungicide after removing the infected leaves.
translated: பாதிக்கப்பட்ட இலைகளை அகற்றிய பிறகு பூஞ்சைக் கொல்லியை தெளிக்கவும்.
back_to_english: After removing the affected leaves, spray fungicide.

english: Use an insecticide only when the pests are many.
translated: பூச்சிகள் அதிகமாக இருக்கும்போது மட்டுமே பூச்சிக்கொல்லியைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
back_to_english: Use pesticide only when pests are in abundance.

english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.
translated: நீங்கள் ஏதேனும் பூச்சிக்கொல்லியை தெளிக்கும்போது கையுறைகள் மற்றும் முகமூடி அணியுங்கள்.
back_to_english: Wear gloves and a mask when you spray any pesticide.

english: Apply the fertilizer after the first weeding.
translated: முதல் களையெடுத்த பிறகு உரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
back_to_english: Use manure after the first weeding.

english: Apply urea in two split doses.
translated: யூரியாவை இரண்டு டோஸ்களாகப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
back_to_english: Use urea in two doses.

english: Mix compost into the soil before sowing.
translated: விதைப்பதற்கு முன் மண்ணில் உரம் கலக்கவும்.
back_to_english: Before sowing, mix the soil with manure.

english: Transplant the seedlings after twenty five days.
translated: இருபத்தைந்து நாட்களுக்குப் பிறகு நாற்றுகளை நடவு செய்யுங்கள்.
back_to_english: Plant the seedlings after twenty-five days.

english: Keep two centimetres of water in the paddy field.
translated: நெல் வயலில் இரண்டு சென்டிமீட்டர் தண்ணீரை வைக்கவும்.
back_to_english: Place two centimeters of water in the paddy field.

english: Groundnut needs light soil with good drainage.
translated: நிலக்கடலைக்கு நல்ல வடிகாலுடன் கூடிய லேசான மண் தேவைப்படுகிறது.
back_to_english: Groundnut requires light soil with good drainage.

english: Pink bollworm is a serious pest of cotton.
translated: இளஞ்சிவப்பு போல்வர்ம் என்பது பருத்தியின் கடுமையான பூச்சி ஆகும்.
back_to_english: The pink polworm is a severe pest of cotton.

english: Chilli plants need water every four days in summer.
translated: மிளகாய் செடிகளுக்கு கோடையில் நான்கு நாட்களுக்கு ஒரு முறை தண்ணீர் தேவைப்படுகிறது.
back_to_english: Chilli plants need water once in four days in summer.

english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.
translated: விதைத்த இருபது நாட்களுக்குப் பிறகு முதல் களையெடுத்தல் செய்யுங்கள்.
back_to_english: Do the first weeding twenty days after sowing.

english: Avoid overhead irrigation to stop the disease spreading.
translated: நோய் பரவுவதைத் தடுக்க மேல்நிலை நீர்ப்பாசனத்தை தவிர்க்கவும்.
back_to_english: Avoid overhead irrigation to prevent the spread of disease.

english: Crop rotation breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.
translated: பயிர் சுழற்சி மண் நோய்களின் வாழ்க்கைச் சுழற்சியை உடைக்கிறது.
back_to_english: The crop cycle breaks the life cycle of soil diseases.

english: Yellowing of lower leaves can mean nitrogen deficiency.
translated: கீழ் இலைகளின் மஞ்சள் நிறம் நைட்ரஜன் குறைபாட்டைக் குறிக்கும்.
back_to_english: The yellow colour of the lower leaves indicates nitrogen deficiency.
